services.title: Steering, suspension and alignment
services.body: Worn steering and suspension parts come off, the replacement goes on beside them, and the alignment is set on the rack afterwards.

services.title: Tires and wheels
services.body: Fitting, balancing and rotation on the machine, with the weights set where they belong.

services.title: Oil changes and routine maintenance
services.body: Oil, filters and fluids are done to the schedule the manufacturer set, with what we found written on the ticket.

evidence.text: These days it's often questionable where to take a vehicle for maintenance & repairs...especially if you're a woman.
evidence.also: For nearly 5 years Gibson's has done everything from oil changes and tires to major repairs for my vehicle.

reviews.author: Doc Burriss
reviews.text: We have been buying our tires at Gibson for several years. We have been a customer since Hoot was in charge. The customer service is great, the staff are all friendly. They now have a second location in Darlington I would recommend Gibson to anyone.

reviews.author: DH Collins
reviews.text: This business has been giving world class service since Hoot opened it, his son, Gene, is carrying on the family tradition.

reviews.author: Marci Viens
reviews.text: I had 2 tires I needed put on and they got me in and out fast! They were super nice and inexpensive! Definitely recommend these guys!!

reviews.author: Cassie Devito
reviews.text: hands down one of the best shops i have been to. they have always been able to fix my car up, even after 3 sets of shocks after they kept breaking, they were able to figure out the problem and get everything squared. i would rather travel to them than to find another mechanic shop bc these people are so awesome at helping people.

reviews.author: Melissa Bryant
reviews.text: Excellent service & Excellent pricing. I'm always confident that I'm getting a job well done. They take care of you as if you're family. These days it's often questionable where to take a vehicle for maintenance & repairs...especially if you're a woman. I feel safe & have been coming here many many years. Often recommend to friends, family & acquaintances.

reviews.author: Denise C
reviews.text: These guys are amazing! I have ongoing problems with nails in my tires ever since moving here 5 years ago, and they are quick and reasonably priced to patch those. I also replaced the tires eventually, and I can’t speak to how their prices on that compare to others. They even put in a headlight bulb for me that I had bought and then couldn’t get at the spot where it went. Besides the tire replacement, I don’t think I’ve ever paid more than $20 for the things they do. Sometimes they get busy and you’ll need to come back, but even during those times I’ve never had anyone be unfriendly. I trust Gibson completely to keep my tires in good shape!

reviews.author: Seiz Ure Life
reviews.text: This buissnes has been in Hartsville for years. They always do a great job on anything tire and brack work that I have needed done. Great group of people to work with. If you need work done, just give them a call and they will be able to give you a price it will cost

reviews.author: Janie Mergler-Wolff
reviews.text: They got me in at the drop of a hat. They were polite, prompt, and professional. And their prices were very reasonable. Highly recommend. Update: I've been here a few times over the past year and am always satisfied with the results amd price.

reviews.author: Frances Hoover
reviews.text: I arrived around 9:30am and dropped my car off with my contact information to get an alignment. After waiting 3 hours with no communication from anyone at the shop, I went to check on my vehicle. When I got there, I was informed that they would not do the alignment because other work needed to be done but the man that was there could not give me a quote for the work. I had to wait another hour to get a quote from someone else and make another trip into town to get my vehicle. The lack of communication denotes absolute disrespect for their customers time and is a clear reflection on the kind of customer service that can be found at this establishment.

reviews.author: Debbie Packer
reviews.text: Driving in Hartsville ensures that you will have tire issues from time to time, but the guys at Gibson always get my car fixed and back on the road quickly. My only issue is that they're always super busy on my day off, but that's just a testament to how good they treat their customers. :-) It's one of the few auto places where I don't feel like I'm being taken advantage of or get treated like a girl who doesn't know about cars. They're very polite and professional.

reviews.author: Margi Moore
reviews.text: Kameron was so nice and thorough upon drop off and pick up! My brakes feel so much better and I will definitely be using Gibson in the future. Thanks for appreciating my business!

reviews.author: Jennifer Smith
reviews.text: Been coming here since I started driving in the 90s. Always great service, fair pricing, and friendly people. Will continue to be a loyal customer.

reviews.author: Deborah Gandy
reviews.text: Gene and his crew have a niche market as they provide hands on service in a business that has become very computerized. They fixed my tire in less than an hour. I know it's repaired correctly and I trust Gene Gibson to keep my tires road ready...safety matters!

reviews.author: Patti Banks
reviews.text: Very friendly and great service. They worked me for an alignment at the last minute and really helped me out in a bind. I would recommend them.

reviews.author: Ron Acord
reviews.text: Very honest and good company to do business with. I took my car for them to check. Come to find out it was something Ward's Radiator had done wrong. It was beyond what Gibson's deals with, so I was not charged anything for them to look at my car.

reviews.author: Glenn Gainey
reviews.text: Very friendly and helpful. They went out of their way to help. While there may be a wait here, it's because they go above and beyond to ensure that customers leave satisfied. Pricing is hard to beat as well.

reviews.author: Cameron Starling
reviews.text: Excellent service. Shipping service needs help. Technician ordered two tires, shipping department shipped one. Not Gibson's fault but a supply difficulty lead to lost time.

reviews.author: Ron Denney
reviews.text: I damaged a tire on my 2013 F150 on my way to Hartsville, SC Monday. It was damaged to the point that it wasn't repairable. Kameron at Gibson Tire was very helpful and polite. He was able to order a matching replacement tire for me and install it Tuesday. He went out of his way to help me get back on the road quickly. The price was also very competitive.

reviews.author: David Dalton
reviews.text: I have used Gibson twice, once to reseat a dolly tire, and again to put four new tires on my 2009 Jeep Grand Cherokee. In both instances the crew was courteous, professional, and quick. I would definitely recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Jessica Carnes
reviews.text: My mom took her Jeep here (even though i tried to talk her out of it) to get a tire replaced (no other issues). When she got it back she said the car was hardly drivable because the front end was all over the place. According to Gibson's, she needed lower ball joints on both sides. After the replaced them, she complained about the front end making a weird noise. Just checked it and the wheel is about to fall off. I messaged them and told them about it and they viewed it, but didn't bother to reply. On my Jeep, a similar situation occurred. I took my vehicle to them to get a tire replaced after getting a nail in one (no other issues) and when I got it back, it felt like it had not been properly balanced or needed an alignment. When I took it back all of a sudden I needed upper and lower ball joints on both sides. So basically they charged me for an alignment for no reason. Will never take another vehicle to these people again!

reviews.author: Jay Morgan
reviews.text: These guys are great. An old-school business that puts the customer first and tries to do right by people. A rarity. I was just passing through, but if I lived here I'd come back for sure.

reviews.author: Mer Allen
reviews.text: For nearly 5 years Gibson's has done everything from oil changes and tires to major repairs for my vehicle. I am always pleased with their workmanship and customer service as they are honest, reliable and friendly.

reviews.author: Jeanne Martin
reviews.text: Traveling with young kids on a Friday afternoon and had a blowout while passing through Hartsville. Gibson Tire put a replacement tire on for us and we were back on the road in under an hour. So grateful to them!

reviews.author: Lafrieda Bacote
reviews.text: Made it to Gibsons on a flat tire. Thought I was going to have to replace the whole tire but the service man replaced the stem and tire was good to go. They were very busy with only two people working but service was still friendly and quick.

reviews.author: Kathy Hopkins
reviews.text: Great service, fair price and busy.. can fix multiple things, not just tires like I thought. Will be my go to place with any issues. If they can’t fix it, they know someone that can!

reviews.author: David A.
reviews.text: Gene and he's team have provided all of my front end work for better than 30 years. They use newer machine for four wheel alignment and thier prices are reasonable.

reviews.author: crystal Edwards
reviews.text: Great group of guys. Had an alignment done and was out in under an hour and was charged the price I was quoted. No hidden fees or surprises. Quality job from a quality shop.

reviews.author: MaryAnn Pritchard
reviews.text: They plugged a tire for me early one morning. They were open at least an hour before all of the other tire places. It was very quick and easy!! In and out.

reviews.author: Melinda Hendrix
reviews.text: The staff here are very accommodating and go above and beyond to make sure you're satisfied. Kameron is genuine and takes time to listen and advise.

reviews.author: Robert James
reviews.text: Got a good price on a set of tires. They installed them late in the day too, nearly to 5pm. I'll definitely recommend them to my friends.

reviews.author: Jeannett Rabon
reviews.text: Gibson's has been servicing my vehicles for many many years. Good service, good personnel and fair prices keep me returning.

reviews.author: Ashley Bennett
reviews.text: When you say you close at 5 you don't close at 4:40 or 4:50. Went to have a tire replaced and took my own tire and was told no i will not put this on i'm leaving its too late for this. SERVICE SUCKS!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Donna Watts
reviews.text: Wouldn't trust the care of our trucks with anyone else. Loyal customer for over 40 years. Great crew!!!!

reviews.author: Alan Hardy
reviews.text: At the price for the set of tires, I was expecting the tires to be brand as was sold. I wouldn't go back because the employes appeared to be homophobic.

reviews.author: Dog Joe
reviews.text: Very helpful n informative about my tire which had a deep gash in it. Kameron took care of my tire right away. Thank you.

reviews.author: Brandy Stellingworth
reviews.text: I’ve had to use this company several times, unexpectedly, and have always received excellent service!

reviews.author: Dawn Valero
reviews.text: The guys there are so kind, helpful, and professional! I definitely recommend using them for your tire needs!!

reviews.author: Brian Ricks
reviews.text: Good place to go to get a wheel alignment, or tire work done. Honest, knowledgeable people. They do good work.

reviews.author: Phillip Wells
reviews.text: Call them told him what vehicle I have. Said I need an alignment they said okay we can do it. But when I get there they can't do it. Why even waste my time.

reviews.author: Virginie Blondel
reviews.text: We are foreigners and were just passing through Hartsville. I went in one morning for a slow flat tire. The welcome was very friendly. My request was dealt with immediately. Efficiency - Helpfulness I highly recommend this place.
